That in turn let `label-cli` claim `scope: AC 1` on the verbatim, in-scope CLI row instead of AC 2. Before held none of these facts, so nothing was lost. To keep the gains stable, keep explicit wording that indices are counted only over surviving rows, that an existing Integration entry is carried first with nested lines intact, and that the companion copy is verbatim rather than summarised.
